notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD is a Gold Winner for NYX Games Awards!
notes.notes:
Greetings Gatekeepers! 

Today, we are proud to share with you all a new goal we achieved: [b]KINGDOM of the DEAD won two Gold awards[/b] for the PC Game: Indie and shooting category! 

The [b]NYX Games Awards[/b] is an international competition that recognizes creativity and technical excellence in the Gaming Industry, and we had the chance to show our game to a talented jury made up of passionate industry veterans. 

With this message, we’d love to take the opportunity to kindly thank the jury of the [b]NYX Games Awards[/b] and to thank all of you for keep supporting us and have fun! 

Now, grab your shotgun and venture into the abyss once again! 

- Alessandro from HOOK

notes.title: KINGDOM of the DEAD is coming!
notes.notes:
[i]East Coast, North America, 19th Century. 
Agent Chamberlain, a professor turned Army General, now works for a secret government program known as GATEKEEPER. Their primary purpose is to defeat the newly empowered Death and his ever-growing army of the dead.[/i]

[b]Are you ready to brave the darkness and remind Death where it belongs?[/b]

After months of development we are excited to announce that our [b]KINGDOM of the DEAD[/b] - an action packed horror themed First Person Shooter - is coming to PC via [b]Steam[/b] this [b]winter[/b]!

KINGDOM of the DEAD blends old school FPS action with unique black and white pen and ink style visuals to create a terrifying gameplay world where players wage war in a deadly battle against Death’s ever growing army.

In KOTD you’ll be able to experience:
[list]
[*][b]Classic FPS gameplay[/b] with different objectives at each difficulty level.
[*][b]Hunt the undead[/b] hordes across multiple remote locations along the US East Coast.
[*]Equip [b]8 weapons[/b] and go toe to toe with over [b]22 undead enemies[/b] and face [b]old school bosses[/b].
[*]Switch up your gameplay experience with a [b]customizable colour palette[/b] and [b]cheat code access[/b]. 
[*]Test your mettle and face off against a never-ending onslaught in the [b]endless gameplay mode[/b].[/list]

We can't wait to share more with you about the game, so join the conversation on our [b]social media[/b] on [url=https://twitter.com/KOTDGAME]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/KOTDGAME/]Reddit[/url]             

Don't forget to add KINGDOM of the DEAD to your [b]wishlist[/b] to stay up to date!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547380/KINGDOM_of_the_DEAD/

See you in the dark,

KOTD Team
